import outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded
import outputs.Proofs.MuonThirdOrderComplexity

namespace outputs.Theorems.MuonThirdOrderBounded

open OracleTemplate

noncomputable def budget : (let S := outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec; S.Params → Fin S.numOracles → ℕ) := fun p _ => ⌈8 * p.J * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 + 2 * p.s * (((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ)) * p.Δ / (3 * p.J * p.ε)⌉₊ + 1

attribute [local simp] budget

theorem result : Convergence outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec budget := by sorry

end outputs.Theorems.MuonThirdOrderBounded
